title: BALLISTIC · 弹道虫
difficulty_note: 人工排序标签 1-5，不是 TIDE 档位、也不是验收项：没有任何工具读取或校验它（全仓库 *.py 检索 difficulty = 0 命中）。与 TIDE 三档无关 —— 那三档是评分基准的强度档（easy/normal/hard），本字段是题库内的相对难度序。截至 2026-11-10 仍无标定方法学，见 docs/known-issues.md。
answer_time_limit_scope: AI build/debug wall clock; harness-enforced; match runtime separate
map_fairness: mirror symmetric 0<3 / 1<2; four equal heights / equal gaps / equal edge margins per elevation level
match_format4: 24 seat permutations (6 circular orders x 4 rotations) x 2 seeds; seed varies per permutation
fault_semantics: simultaneous move conflicts are NOT faults (RULES 6.4)

turn_budget.formula: turn_budget_ms = 50 * s * c(jobs), c = min(1.75, 1 + 0.03*(jobs-1)), c = 1 when jobs <= 1 (see concurrency.factor)

landmark.host: Intel Core i9-14900HX (8P+16E, 32 threads), Windows, MinGW g++ 16.1 (reference host, s = 1.0)
landmark.method: tools/p01_calibrate.py, 32 fixed positions x 40 repeats, median per-turn CPU

rank_host_requirement.note: scalar scaling restores speed, not jitter; see RULES 15.2

concurrency.method: 24 seat permutations x 6 seeds = 144 games/level, 4 identical bots, public4-01; wall_allow_s = 0.25*(jobs-1)
concurrency.note: Ranking/mixed heavy bots: jobs<=20 (throughput note only; see docs/crossplatform-and-host-speed.md section 7). The budget itself now compensates for concurrency, see factor below.

factor.formula: turn_budget_ms = 50 * s * c(jobs); c = min(1.75, 1 + 0.03*(jobs-1)); c = 1 when jobs <= 1
factor.why: s is calibrated single-process (p01_calibrate.py, jobs=1) but ranking runs at jobs=20; concurrency alone raises per-turn CPU 1.43-1.64x (p01-audit/concurrency_sweep2.log). Constant is deliberately conservative: measured 1.64x at 24 jobs, capped at 1.75x. Without it the effective budget at jobs=20 is ~70% of the single-process figure.
